entries.prompt: Generate GT01 S03 SEAT TRACK ASSEMBLY / R1 detailed technical reference sheet at the minimum visual clarity of a wheel manufacturing drawing. Use the supplied tan sports seat sheet only for the seat identity and existing twin fore-aft track layout; DO NOT copy its rejected panel5 where a screw passes through the rolling channel. This is an authored plausible MECHANICAL SHAPE reference not certified engineering. White page 3x2 large panels: 1 fully assembled twin seat tracks with cross release U-bar 3/4; 2 one track exploded along vertical depth showing LOWER folded steel channel with two OUTBOARD mounting feet with real through slots, nested upper rail, two lateral ball races and slender retainers, end stops, lock comb, return torsion spring, release pivot and pins as separate units with IDs S03-L01 lower, U01 upper, B01 ball, C01 cage, K01 lock comb, R01 spring, P01 pin, E01 stop, H01 release bar. 3 upper/side/top orthographics of one complete rail with moving vs fixed highlighted subtly. 4 enlarged transverse section: curled lower channel outer lips, nested upper C-section inner returns, steel balls captured in LEFT and RIGHT SIDE raceways, central sliding neck unobstructed, very clear separate contours and running clearance; mount bolts through external lateral feet well OUTSIDE the rolling channel. 5 enlarged toothed lock comb pivoting to engage rack windows in fixed rail, pin through aligned coaxial ears, torsion spring legs actually resting against two hosts. 6 assembly sequence with same parts: lower rails and retained balls, insert upper rails longitudinally, install end stops, install lock comb/spring/pivot and release bar, final twin rail. All views agree, no extra rails or incompatible cross sections. Precise steel folded lips, pressed webs, cut windows, cylindrical bearing balls, positive contact placement. No seat cushion hiding parts; only tiny ghosted seat mounting tabs in overview. Short English identifiers with legible thin leaders, no crowded callouts or spurious dimensions. Large high-definition individual component visual reference with full assembly and decomposition.

High resolution landscape technical SHAPE drawing on white paper, black precise linework and realistic material shading, six spacious panels FRONT / REAR / SIDE / ISOMETRIC / SECTION / ENLARGED CONNECTION. Footer AUTHOR DESIGN / INDIVIDUAL PART REFERENCE. Subject GT01 D05-P01 / FRONT GUIDE RAIL / R1. One tall narrow slightly curved zinc-plated STAMPED STEEL GUIDE RAIL, length roughly twelve times width. Channel cross-section shaped to capture a sliding carriage: central recessed running web, raised left/right guiding flanges with small returned edges. Two pierced mounting tabs, one near each end. One round pulley-axle bore at the upper end and one at the lower end, both actual see-through holes. Long central formed strengthening rib, two short punched slots in the web, realistic thin stamped sheet wall and rounded fold radii. The rear view must show the corresponding folded channel not a different solid bar. Section panel cuts transversely through the channel and must match side/end silhouette, crosshatching only the metal wall. Enlarged detail shows the formed upper pulley mounting ear and THROUGH axle hole with flange thickness. DO NOT show pulley, carriage, cable, motor, bolts installed; faint dotted mating outline of carriage permitted only in small connection inset. This is one piece of metal, fully separately modelable, crisp edges and negative spaces.

Coherent one component across every view. No dimensions, tolerances, scales or factory certification. Footer AUTHOR DESIGN / INDIVIDUAL PART REFERENCE. GT01 D05-P03 / FRONT SLIDING CARRIAGE / R1. Single ivory-white moulded engineering polymer carriage fitted around the stamped guide-rail returns in image1. Image2 shows parent mechanism. Modelable detailed shape: one compact roughly rectangular ribbed main web; two parallel shallow C-shaped guide shoes on rear side wrapping the rail return lips; two opposed steel cable nipple sockets, one upward-opening at top and one downward-opening at bottom; ONE large central THROUGH bolt hole for a separate glass clamp and two locating pins on the FRONT face. Visible molded reinforcing ribs terminate at the round boltboss; shallow weight-saving blind pockets, rounded moulding corners, two small assembly slots. Section through the two C guide shoes includes pale dashed outline of image1 rail in the connection inset only, realistic sliding clearance, not fused solid. No glass, no clamp, no metal bolt, no cable or rail present in main views: it is ONLY the separately molded sliding carriage. State stable holes same all views.
